# GEOX — Earth Intelligence Sovereign Kernel (31 Public Tools)
> Doctrine: Physics before narrative. Governed evidence only.
> Surface: generated from registry.py::CANONICAL_PUBLIC_TOOLS
> Capability families: 9 | Sprint 1 classified

## 1. Capability Graph — Tool Surface

### 1. Evidence & Orientation

- **geox_basin** [Tier A — Core]: Unified basin intelligence: profile, resolve, macrostrat, backstrip, mass balance, thermal maturity, map context, deep time, tectonic reconstruction.
- **geox_claim** [Tier A — Core]: Claim lifecycle: create, validate, challenge, seal, evidence, falsify, synthesize, contradict. Modes: create, validate, challenge, seal, attach, falsify, discover, synthesize, abduct, contradict, scan.
- **geox_deep_time** [Tier A — Core]: Deep time: Earth state, dynamical systems, DDE reasoning. Modes: dde_reason.
- **geox_paleobiodb_query** [Tier B — Specialist]: Query the Paleobiology Database (PBDB v1.2) for taxa, occurrences, and biozones. Modes: taxa (resolve a taxon), occurrence (fossil occurrence records), zone (biozones by scale), age_intervals (ICS / nanno / foram zones). Read-only, public-domain fossil data.
- **geox_source** [Tier A — Core]: Source rock & diagenesis: TOC, kerogen, maturity, compaction. Modes: source_rock, diagenesis.
- **geox_spatial** [Tier A — Core]: Spatial intelligence: H3, LanceDB, STAC. Modes: h3_index, lancedb_store, stac_discover.
- **geox_temporal** [Tier A — Core]: Temporal analytics: decline curve, RRR, basin lifecycle, cadence. Modes: decline, rrr, basin_lifecycle, cadence.

### 2. Data Intake & QC

- **geox_seismic_ingest** [Tier B — Specialist]: SEG-Y I/O, header inspection, export.
- **geox_well_ingest** [Tier B — Specialist]: Load well log data from LAS, SEG-Y, DST, deviation, or tops files. Auto-detects format.
- **geox_well_qc** [Tier A — Core]: Quality control for well data: depth monotonicity, null %, physical range checks.

### 3. Earth Interpretation

- **geox_contrast_metabolize** [Tier B — Specialist]: Unified anomalous contrast metabolic pipeline. Binds three stages into one call: ISOLATE (deterministic acoustic impedance contrast detection) then MEASURE (AVO gradient + LMR estimates) then CLASSIFY (>=3 stratigraphic trap hypotheses). substrate_class=INERT. Local max QUALIFIED_CANDIDATE - arifOS seals.
- **geox_geomechanics** [Tier B — Specialist]: Geomechanical analysis: bulk/shear/young modulus, poisson ratio, acoustic impedance, stress polygon.
- **geox_petrophysics** [Tier A — Core]: Unified petrophysics: Vsh, porosity, Sw, permeability, net pay, LEM inference, QC. Modes: generate, verify, lem_inference, stoip_feed, qc.
- **geox_seismic_compute** [Tier B — Specialist]: Seismic computation: forward model, well tie, attributes, wavelet extraction, inversion.
- **geox_seismic_interpret** [Tier A — Core]: One semantic capability — propose geometry, physics-gate, compare hypotheses (NOT autonomous SEAL). Live modes: horizon_contrast, fault_sticks, volume_frame, blend, structure_validate, interpret (interpretation_bundle ≥3 hyps), interpret_section/rsi_pipeline (INT_SEISMIC), segy_slice. Gates return PASS|WARN|KILL|UNMEASURED + receipt_hash. preferred_hypothesis always null from GEOX. Local max QUALIFIED_CANDIDATE — arifOS seals only.
- **geox_well** [Tier A — Core]: Well intelligence: view curves, open desk, desurvey. Modes: view, desk.

### 4. Integration & Models

- **geox_model** [Tier A — Core]: Geological modeling: subsurface inversion, 2D cross-sections, GemPy 3D. Modes: subsurface, geological_generate, gempy_3d.

### 5. Prospect & Decision

- **geox_prospect** [Tier A — Core]: Prospect evaluation: volumetrics, POS, EVOI, risk assessment. Modes: screen, evaluate.

### 6. Presentation

- **geox_map** [Tier A — Core]: Map intelligence: layer discovery, scene composition, preview. Modes: layers_list, scene_plan, render_preview.

### 7. Research / Cascade Lab

- **geox_glof_cascade_initialize** [Tier C — Research]: GLOF cascade simulation init. Accepts 33D GEOXEarthState33 (M9+P9+W9+X6 zen-33) or defaults to himalayan_glof_33. Returns session state_id.
- **geox_glof_cascade_inverse** [Tier C — Research]: Bayesian grid-search inference on 33D posterior from wave observations (W obs). Returns inferred theta_hat + log_likelihood + posterior_summary.
- **geox_glof_cascade_mcmc_inverse** [Tier C — Research]: Phase C — proper Bayesian posterior via adaptive Metropolis-Hastings MCMC. Replaces grid search. Returns posterior mean, std, percentiles, R-hat, ESS, accept_rate, n_samples. Sampling on (E, c, phi, tau_0, sigma_t, phi_p).
- **geox_glof_cascade_metabolize** [Tier C — Research]: Close F-I-M loop on 33D state. Emit FIMReceipt33 with tri-witness G-score, phase transitions, cycle_id.
- **geox_glof_cascade_phase** [Tier C — Research]: Yield surface eval on 33D state. Returns Mohr-Coulomb/Voellmy verdict + 33D-derived sigma_eff, tau_max, breach_probability_33D, hydro_fracture indicator.
- **geox_glof_cascade_propagate** [Tier C — Research]: Phase C — 1D Saint-Venant (shallow-water) wave propagation from breach to downstream. Lax-Friedrichs finite-volume solver with Manning friction. Returns time series of (h, u, Q) along domain + peak downstream Q/time/depth/velocity.
- **geox_glof_cascade_step** [Tier C — Research]: Advance 33D GLOF state by n_steps. Uses metabolize_33 closure + forward_kinematics to derive W (Vp,Vs,alpha_B). Returns evolved 33D state.

## 2. Tier Legend
- **Tier A (Core)**: Default discovery. All agents see these.
- **Tier B (Specialist)**: Opt-in after task declaration.
- **Tier C (Research)**: Advanced/research. Not visible by default.

## 3. Capability Packs

### earth_core (Tier A — 13 tools)
Default discovery surface. Basin context, data validation, well/seismic interpretation, prospect assessment.

### earth_specialist (Tier B — 6 tools)
Opt-in. Seismic computation, geomechanics, data ingestion, paleobiology.

### earth_research (Tier C — 7 tools)
Advanced/research only. Sub-packs:
- **cascade** (5): GLOF cascade simulation (initialize, step, phase, metabolize, propagate)
- **inversion** (2): Bayesian inference (inverse, mcmc_inverse)
- **restoration** (0): Structural restoration (PLANNED)
- **simulation** (0): Stratigraphic simulation (PLANNED)
- **uncertainty** (0): Uncertainty quantification (PLANNED)

## 4. Workflow Packs

### well_to_correlation (7 steps → CorrelationPackage)
basin → well → well_qc → petrophysics → deep_time → model → map

### seismic_to_prospect (8 steps → ProspectEvidencePackage)
basin → seismic_ingest → seismic_compute → seismic_interpret → geomechanics → model → prospect → claim

### basin_screening (8 steps → PlayFairwaySummary)
basin → spatial → temporal → source → deep_time → claim → prospect → map

### glof_uncertainty (6 steps → UncertaintyReport)
initialize → propagate → phase → inverse → mcmc_inverse → metabolize

## 5. Agent Reasoning Logic
- Evidence before interpretation.
- Governance stays server-side.
- App-enabled workspace URI: `ui://geox/workspace-v1.html` (text/html;profile=mcp-app).
